note: Beat sheets per genre as percent of runtime, with target ASL (average shot length = runtime / shots), on-screen text ceilings, music intensity 0-1 (0 = no music, 1 = the loudest, densest moment of the piece) and the sound-design role of each section. Every number is a tunable default with an evidence grade; no platform publishes beat percentages. The sources, the hedging and the named examples are in docs/research/launch-video-patterns.md (the `evidence` anchor of each structure). Sections may overlap where sources disagree (a reveal inside the demo); `required: false` sections are scored only when present. tools/structure_check.py scores an out/plan.json against one of these.

grades.practitioner: editors, creators, agencies, vendors: belief from practice
grades.inference: our synthesis of the sources; a tunable house default

text.cps_note: a streaming service subtitle standard: 20 cps for adult programmes, 17 for children; 17 is the default for a broad phone audience (sources: the research doc)

multi-voice-doc.why: launch-playbook L9 (the template demo is a 29 s compression of the 105-180 s shape)

film-scene.why: an 8 s scene (establishing, action, reaction, payoff) is one beat of a short film, not a whole film; score a full film with --pattern short-film

talking-head.why: the demo is 6.5 s of placeholder talk with no sections (it proves autocut and captions); score a real edit with --pattern podcast-clip, vlog or tutorial

course-lesson.why: a lesson is an explainer with recap and quiz; no separate lesson pattern yet

explainer-diagram.why: question, wrong model, reframe, proof, so-what: the diagram walk-through (lane explainer)

data-story.why: data-journalism short: hook, context chart, the number that matters, breakdown, takeaway with sources (lane explainer)

process-howto.why: numbered steps on a timeline, before / after, checklist end card (lane explainer)

ad-15.label: 15 s in-feed or pre-roll ad: hook, problem, product, proof, CTA

sections.name: hook
sections.sfx_role: an impact on frame 0 (sfx/hit/*); a whoosh peaks on the first cut

sections.name: problem
sections.sfx_role: a pop per card; a riser starts under the last problem shot

sections.name: product
sections.sfx_role: the riser ends one frame before the reveal; a cinema hit on the reveal

sections.name: proof
sections.sfx_role: soft ticks per state change; one hit on a sourced number

sections.name: cta
sections.sfx_role: a sonic logo on the end card; the last 0.15 s silent

ad-15.cutdowns_note: sections to keep, in order, when the film is cut to N seconds; the kept sections are re-timed to their share of the pattern. Practitioners ask for 30, 15 and 6 s cut-downs of a launch film and say a 30-45 s social cut folds the problem into the hook and drops the proof; the section lists are our inference

ad-30.label: 30 s ad: hook with the value inside 3 s, problem, product, proof, CTA

sections.name: hook
sections.sfx_role: an impact on frame 0; a whoosh peaks on the first cut

sections.name: problem
sections.sfx_role: pops on cards; foley on the pain; a riser into the reveal

sections.name: product
sections.sfx_role: a hit on the reveal; one UI sound per action under the demo

sections.name: proof
sections.sfx_role: ticks per state change; one soft hit on the sourced number

sections.name: cta
sections.sfx_role: a sonic logo; decelerate before the ask (cuts/sections breath_out)

ad-30.cutdowns_note: sections to keep, in order, when the film is cut to N seconds; the kept sections are re-timed to their share of the pattern. saas-launch.label: SaaS / AI product launch film (product UI film): promise, context, reveal, workflow demo, proof, end card

sections.name: hook
sections.sfx_role: music already running or one hit on frame 0; UI clicks if the hook is the product working

sections.name: context
sections.sfx_role: a riser across the context that ends one frame before the name
sections.note: big-brand release films often skip it; challenger launches keep it

sections.name: reveal
sections.sfx_role: a short silence (0.3-1 s) then an impact on the product name

sections.name: demo
sections.sfx_role: one UI sound per action (typing, click, success); cuts on the beat

sections.name: proof
sections.sfx_role: energy pulls back; one soft hit on the sourced number

sections.name: cta
sections.sfx_role: a final hit on the end card, then a quiet hold or sonic logo

saas-launch.cutdowns_note: sections to keep, in order, when the film is cut to N seconds; the kept sections are re-timed to their share of the pattern. saas-feature-drop.label: Single-feature drop: intro, the feature working in real UI, use cases, outro

sections.name: intro
sections.sfx_role: the first UI action on frame 0-3 (a keystroke or click), or ambient air

sections.name: demo
sections.sfx_role: one UI sound per action; soft whoosh on panel moves; no VO needed

sections.name: usecases
sections.sfx_role: a tick per use-case card

sections.name: outro
sections.sfx_role: a soft hit on the lockup, then a quiet hold

saas-feature-drop.cutdowns_note: sections to keep, in order, when the film is cut to N seconds; the kept sections are re-timed to their share of the pattern. explainer.label: Explainer: question, wrong model, the reframe, proof, so-what

sections.name: question
sections.sfx_role: one sound on the question line; a planned quiet open is fine

sections.name: wrongmodel
sections.sfx_role: diagram ticks; a low pulse under the confusion

sections.name: reframe
sections.sfx_role: a soft hit on the reframe; ticks per diagram step, only in speech gaps

sections.name: proof
sections.sfx_role: one hit on the example landing

sections.name: sowhat
sections.sfx_role: a quiet hold under the takeaway

explainer.cutdowns_note: sections to keep, in order, when the film is cut to N seconds; the kept sections are re-timed to their share of the pattern. hardware-reveal.label: Hardware reveal film (keynote insert or standalone): dark open, macro tease, hero reveal on a hit, transform, specs, the job, end card

sections.name: open
sections.sfx_role: a sub swell or a single tone as the light finds the edge; never silence on frame 0

sections.name: tease
sections.sfx_role: a tick or soft hit on each new detail; a riser builds

sections.name: reveal
sections.sfx_role: a silent beat, then the hit on the first full-product frame

sections.name: transform
sections.sfx_role: mechanical foley on each part; whoosh on the explode

sections.name: specs
sections.sfx_role: one hit per spec card on the beat

sections.name: job
sections.sfx_role: room tone and the product doing its job

sections.name: endcard
sections.sfx_role: the music falls to silence or a sonic logo under the name

hardware-reveal.cutdowns_note: sections to keep, in order, when the film is cut to N seconds; the kept sections are re-timed to their share of the pattern. Practitioners ask for 30, 15 and 6 s cut-downs of a launch film and say a 30-45 s social cut folds the problem into the hook and drops the proof; the section lists are our inference

teaser.label: Teaser: one striking image, a single-cue build, a hit, the title, a date

sections.name: hook
sections.sfx_role: one striking sound with the image

sections.name: build
sections.sfx_role: one music cue; risers and drones; no plot

sections.name: peak
sections.sfx_role: a hit or braam, then a cut to black

sections.name: title
sections.sfx_role: a stinger on the title

sections.name: date
sections.sfx_role: a quiet tail under the date

trailer.label: Trailer: cold open, act 1 setup, act 2 escalation, act 3 crescendo, silence, title, button, date

sections.name: coldopen
sections.sfx_role: near-silent or a line of dialogue alone; one hit out of it

sections.name: act1
sections.sfx_role: sparse drone or ambient texture; a copy card on a soft whoosh

sections.name: act2
sections.sfx_role: percussion enters; whooshes on cards; a pull-out or silence before the key line

sections.name: act3
sections.sfx_role: riser to hit; braams and sub impacts on cuts to black; the fastest cutting

sections.name: title
sections.sfx_role: a planned gap (silence or a sub-only tail), then the title hit

sections.name: button
sections.sfx_role: one last line or sting after the title

sections.name: date
sections.sfx_role: a quiet tail or one low hit under the date card

trailer.cutdowns_note: sections to keep, in order, when the film is cut to N seconds; the kept sections are re-timed to their share of the pattern. Practitioners ask for 30, 15 and 6 s cut-downs of a launch film and say a 30-45 s social cut folds the problem into the hook and drops the proof; the section lists are our inference

title-sequence.label: Title sequence: a motif, a credit cascade paced to the music, the main title last

sections.name: motif
sections.sfx_role: one sound motif with the visual metaphor

sections.name: credits
sections.sfx_role: one credit per musical bar; no hit on every card

sections.name: build
sections.sfx_role: the phrase builds to its resolution

sections.name: maintitle
sections.sfx_role: the main title lands on the final musical resolution

tutorial.label: Tutorial: the end result first, the promise, the steps, a recap, the end screen

sections.name: hook
sections.sfx_role: one sound on the result shot; then the voice leads

sections.name: promise
sections.sfx_role: the bed ducks under the voice

sections.name: steps
sections.sfx_role: a tick per step card; UI sounds under screen capture; the bed stays ducked

sections.name: recap
sections.sfx_role: a soft lift for the recap

sections.name: endscreen
sections.sfx_role: the bed returns under the end screen

vlog.label: Vlog / personal story: cold open at the key moment, setup and want, the journey (but / therefore), the cost, the change, sign-off

sections.name: coldopen
sections.sfx_role: the moment's own sound first (a line, a door, a laugh)

sections.name: setup
sections.sfx_role: room tone; music only between talking beats

sections.name: journey
sections.sfx_role: a music change at each re-hook; foley on contacts

sections.name: cost
sections.sfx_role: silence before the turn (200-400 ms), then the bed returns

sections.name: change
sections.sfx_role: the score resolves under the face

sections.name: signoff
sections.sfx_role: a familiar sign-off sound under the end screen

podcast-clip.label: Podcast / interview clip: the sharpest line first, the context, the payoff, a button

sections.name: hook
sections.sfx_role: the voice alone; a soft sweetener on the first punch-in at most

sections.name: context
sections.sfx_role: the restored host question; a low bed (if any) ducked under both voices

sections.name: payoff
sections.sfx_role: a sweetener on punch-ins (max one per 4 s); nothing over the words

sections.name: button
sections.sfx_role: the punchline lands dry; a soft tag under "full episode"

podcast-clip.cutdowns_note: sections to keep, in order, when the film is cut to N seconds; the kept sections are re-timed to their share of the pattern. Practitioners ask for 30, 15 and 6 s cut-downs of a launch film and say a 30-45 s social cut folds the problem into the hook and drops the proof; the section lists are our inference

founder-story.label: Founder launch: a person with a stake to camera, the why, the problem, the demo, one proof, the smallest ask

sections.name: hook
sections.sfx_role: the voice alone, no music, few or no cuts

sections.name: why
sections.sfx_role: music enters after the opening statement, low under the voice

sections.name: problem
sections.sfx_role: B-roll sound only where it compresses a sentence

sections.name: demo
sections.sfx_role: UI sounds under the real product; the bed rises under B-roll

sections.name: proof
sections.sfx_role: one soft hit on one sourced number

sections.name: ask
sections.sfx_role: the bed resolves under the URL; a quiet hold

founder-story.cutdowns_note: sections to keep, in order, when the film is cut to N seconds; the kept sections are re-timed to their share of the pattern. Practitioners ask for 30, 15 and 6 s cut-downs of a launch film and say a 30-45 s social cut folds the problem into the hook and drops the proof; the section lists are our inference

short-film.label: Short film: cold open image, world and want, one obstacle, the turn, consequence, resolution image, tag

sections.name: coldopen
sections.sfx_role: room tone and one diegetic sound

sections.name: want
sections.sfx_role: room tone under every scene; the score waits

sections.name: obstacle
sections.sfx_role: foley on every contact; tension in the room tone

sections.name: turn
sections.sfx_role: 200-400 ms of silence before the turn; the score enters on emotion

sections.name: consequence
sections.sfx_role: the score carries the reaction

sections.name: resolution
sections.sfx_role: the score resolves on the image

sections.name: tag
sections.sfx_role: a quiet tail; at most 6 s

character-spot.label: Wordless character spot (one gag, one feature): hook, setup, escalation, twist, reaction hold, message

sections.name: hook
sections.sfx_role: a cartoon sound on the premise; word-free babble

sections.name: setup
sections.sfx_role: foley on each contact

sections.name: escalation
sections.sfx_role: escalating cartoon sounds; a freeze before the twist

sections.name: twist
sections.sfx_role: the twist on a smash with its sweetener

sections.name: reaction
sections.sfx_role: a 1.5 s reaction hold; one emotion sound

sections.name: message
sections.sfx_role: a stinger on the end line

documentary-launch.label: Multi-voice documentary launch: voices cold open, the lead, chapters (speaker, insert, B-roll), proof, availability, the lead closes, a quiet hold

sections.name: voices
sections.sfx_role: the audio leads every cut; mid-sentence voices

sections.name: lead
sections.sfx_role: the bed ducked 12 dB under the lead

sections.name: chapters
sections.sfx_role: speaker changes in the breath between lines; one tick per insert

sections.name: proof
sections.sfx_role: one soft hit on the proof card

sections.name: availability
sections.sfx_role: the bed rises for the offer

sections.name: close
sections.sfx_role: the lead closes over a ducked bed

sections.name: end
sections.sfx_role: the bed holds 1.8 s, then a quiet hold at -30 dB

proof-film.label: Proof film: a claim, the name, the method, one builder, head-to-head, big numbers, three cards, the URL on a quiet hold

sections.name: claim
sections.sfx_role: a planned quiet open; the sound enters on the accent word

sections.name: name
sections.sfx_role: a tick on the name

sections.name: setting
sections.sfx_role: a tick per method line

sections.name: builder
sections.sfx_role: a tick per state change; no hit until the number

sections.name: h2h
sections.sfx_role: a tick per row

sections.name: numbers
sections.sfx_role: ONE soft hit on the number reveal

sections.name: cards
sections.sfx_role: a pop per stat card

sections.name: end
sections.sfx_role: no stinger; a quiet hold under the URL

beat-edit.label: Music-led beat edit: intro, a build that accelerates, the drop at double time, the out

sections.name: intro
sections.sfx_role: the track itself; a flash sweetener on the section change

sections.name: build
sections.sfx_role: the riser ends one frame before the drop

sections.name: drop
sections.sfx_role: hits on the grid only, never between beats

sections.name: out
sections.sfx_role: breathe out; loop seam or end hit

data-story.label: Data story: the question over a chart already drawing, the baseline chart with one annotation, the number that matters, the honest comparison, a breakdown, the takeaway with every source

sections.name: hook
sections.sfx_role: one sound as the first data lands; a planned quiet open is fine

sections.name: context
sections.sfx_role: a soft run as the chart builds; one pop on the annotation

sections.name: evidence
sections.sfx_role: a count run under the number, one soft hit when it lands

sections.name: detail
sections.sfx_role: a tick per scrolly step or highlight

sections.name: takeaway
sections.sfx_role: a quiet hold under the takeaway and the sources

process-howto.label: Process how-to: the promise with the steps already on screen, numbered steps on a timeline, the before / after, a checklist end card

sections.name: hook
sections.sfx_role: one sound on frame 0-3 as the steps appear

sections.name: steps
sections.sfx_role: a tick per step, a soft success when the last one is done

sections.name: result
sections.sfx_role: a wipe sound on the after reveal

sections.name: checklist
sections.sfx_role: a pop per ticked item, then a quiet hold
